## Pre-merge checklist

- [ ] **No real data**: no real camper, leader or parent details in code, tests, fixtures, logs or screenshots
- [ ] **README.md**: reviewed; updated if the feature list or run instructions changed
- [ ] **docs/decisions/**: checked for new or closed architectural decisions; ADR added if needed
- [ ] **Design spec**: `docs/superpowers/specs/` still matches what this PR does; updated if not
- [ ] **Print**: any printout still works in greyscale and on the real printer (if it changed)
- [ ] **Build passes**: build and tests succeed locally
